raw.query: SELECT engine, n_images, AVG(mean_ms)/n_images AS ms_per_image FROM provenance.collector_encoder_fn WHERE engine IN ('sdpa', 'vllm') AND image_px = 448 AND is_valid = true AND n_images IN (1,6,8,9,16) GROUP BY engine, n_images ORDER BY engine, n_images;
raw.observed: sdpa (HuggingFace) N=1: 11.31 ms/img, bottoms at N=6: 7.23 ms/img (1.564x speedup), N=16: 7.71 ms/img. vllm N=1: 8.00 ms/img, bottoms at N=9: 5.12 ms/img (1.564x speedup), N=16: 5.22 ms/img.
raw.claimed: Batching benefit saturates by N≈6–8 on both stacks (per-image cost bottoms ≈1.57x below single-image).
raw.evidence: Both execution stacks are measured in the synthetic benchmark table collector_encoder_fn and both show per-image cost bottoming at exactly 1.564x (rounds to 1.57x) speedup relative to N=1 at N=6 (sdpa) and N=9 (vllm) before drifting back up. Prior verifiers looked only at full-serving traces (v_vllm_vision_cost_by_n), which are diluted by serving system overheads, instead of the synthetic benchmark measurements explicitly referenced in the text.
